mapper.sql: SELECT a.*, p.name AS pet_name, p.breed, c.name AS owner_name, c.phone AS owner_phone, s.name AS service_name, b.bill_no AS bill_no FROM appointment a JOIN pet p ON p.id = a.pet_id JOIN customer c ON c.id = a.customer_id JOIN service_item s ON s.id = a.service_id LEFT JOIN bill b ON b.id = a.bill_id
mapper.select: WHERE a.appoint_date = #{date} ORDER BY a.slot ASC, a.id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO appointment(customer_id, pet_id, service_id, appoint_date, slot, size_tier, status, remark, created_at, created_by) VALUES(#{customerId}, #{petId}, #{serviceId}, #{appointDate}, #{slot}, #{sizeTier}, #{status}, #{remark}, #{createdAt}, #{createdBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE appointment SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'BOOKED'
UPDATE appointment SET status = 'DONE', bill_id = #{billId} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'ARRIVED'
UPDATE appointment SET status = 'DONE', bill_id = #{billId} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'ARRIVED' AND customer_id = #{customerId}
mapper.select: WHERE a.status = 'BOOKED' AND a.appoint_date < #{today} ORDER BY a.appoint_date ASC
